newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Dec 9.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on December 9. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Texmaco Group expected to be ready to assemble trucks by 1998 under an agreement with British Leyland.
National carrier Garuda raised its domestic cargo handling fees by 30 to 35 percent as of December 1, after beginning a new cargo service earlier this year.

The official National Commission on Human Rights is willing to discuss its role in Indonesian society, commission chairman Munawir Sjadzali said. The army has called for the boundaries of the commission's authority to be reviewed.
Seventeen people died in an air crash after the engine of the plane they were in caught fire minutes after taking off from Banjarmasin's Syamsuddin Noor airport in south Kalimantan.
President Suharto warned Indonesians not to proselytise others with their spiritual beliefs as it was not in line with the country's constitution which recognises all major religions.
